about.title: About Me
about.intro:
I work as a Full Stack .NET Developer at AVIPAM, contributing to corporate systems, web portals, and API integrations. In that environment, I work with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Web Forms, SQL Server, and Bootstrap, with Azure DevOps and AWS in delivery and operations workflows.

I also created ForjaX Mobile, an independent initiative where I build, publish, and maintain Android apps used by people. My independent projects let me work with technologies beyond my corporate stack, including React Native, Expo, and TypeScript; local storage and monitoring tools vary by product.

I enjoy carrying a product from a real problem through implementation, publication, and ongoing improvement.
